# mapbox fonts

Fonts API

Mapbox Font Service

3 commands. A description too long for its table cell is shortened here; `mapbox --schema <command>` has the whole of every one, as JSON. Placeholders in the examples are written in `UPPER_CASE` and have to be replaced.

## Commands

### mapbox fonts delete

Delete a font

Requires `fonts:write` scope. Returns 204 even if the font does not exist.

`DELETE https://api.mapbox.com/fonts/v1/{owner}/{face}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `face` | `FACE` | yes | string |  | Sent in the request path. |
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Print the request this would send, then exit without sending it. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{owner}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox fonts delete --username USERNAME FACE
```

### mapbox fonts list

List fonts for an owner

Requires `fonts:list` scope.

`GET https://api.mapbox.com/fonts/v1/{owner}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{owner}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox fonts list --username USERNAME
```

### mapbox fonts upload

Upload a font

Requires `fonts:write` scope. Accepts raw font file (max ~30MB).

`POST https://api.mapbox.com/fonts/v1/{owner}`

| Argument | Written as | Required | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dry-run` | `--dry-run` | no | boolean |  | Print the request this would send, then exit without sending it. |
| `file` | `--file PATH` | yes | path |  | File whose bytes are sent as the request body (application/octet-stream). Sent in the request body. Sent as `application/octet-stream`. |
| `username` | `--username USERNAME` `-u` (global) | yes | string |  | Fills the account placeholder in the URL. See `--username` under global_options for where the value may come from. Sent in the request path. Fills `{owner}` in the URL. |

```sh
mapbox fonts upload --username USERNAME --file PATH
```
